_source: BUG-640 (2026-11-01, owner decision via the PM). OpenAlex's is_retracted is used only when OpenAlex is already asked for the entry (the title-search fallback), only as a Low lead to verify, and never counts for readiness. Measured: of 30 DOI-bearing works OpenAlex marks retracted, Crossref records a retraction for 17; of the other 12, about 10 are retraction notices. A notice is never treated as a retracted work, and a retracted work is never called a notice.
_notice_note: A lead needs OpenAlex's own signal: is_retracted, or a record OpenAlex types as a retraction. A record is a notice when OpenAlex types it so, or when its title opens with a phrase only notices use. 'Retracted:', 'RETRACTED:', 'Notice of Retraction' and 'Withdrawn' are NOT notice phrases: publishers retitle the retracted work itself that way (backend review, BUG-640), and on this DOI-less path most such records are the works. Matched case-insensitively at the start of the title. This title rule is for OpenAlex records reached by title search only; an entry cited by DOI is named a notice from Crossref's relations, never its title (Hindawi titles its notices 'Retracted: ...').
_reason_note: The not-counted line under the finding says it does not count; the reason does not repeat it. {link} names the link: the publisher's page for a DOI, otherwise the OpenAlex record.
retracted_work_reason: OpenAlex lists this work ('{title}') as possibly retracted. Crossref's title search did not find it, so this could not be confirmed there. Please check {link}.
retracted_work_reason_crossref_not_asked: OpenAlex lists this work ('{title}') as possibly retracted. Crossref was not searched for it, so this is not confirmed. Please check {link}.
notice_reason: This entry matches a retraction notice ('{title}'), not the research paper it retracts. Please check which one the entry means to cite ({link}).
_doi_notice_note: BUG-683: an entry whose DOI's own Crossref record is a retraction notice (its retraction relation points at another DOI). Same kind and label as a notice OpenAlex lists; {retracted} names the retracted paper's link(s). Only for a lookup by the cited DOI. This file's path setting (citation_openalex_retraction_lead_file) governs both leads.
doi_notice_reason: This entry's DOI leads to a retraction notice ('{title}'), not to the research paper it retracts ({retracted}). Please check which one the entry means to cite.
link_unknown: the title on the publisher's site (the record could not be linked)
